story.title: Story 3: Archive Read and Reopen Surface

result.reviewScopeSummary: Follow-up verification focused on the prior bounded-page blocker. Re-read the Story 3 bounded-page requirement and Flow 3 design note, inspected the updated Convex archive read path and directly touched fake Convex test helper, then reran focused archive tests and the full story gate.

priorFindingStatuses.rationale: `convex/archiveEntries.ts:139-167` now applies the cursor in the indexed query and reads only `limit + 1` rows with `.take(...)` instead of loading the full archive with `.collect()`. Focused archive tests passed, and `corepack pnpm run green-verify` also passed with the updated production path.

gatesRun.command: corepack pnpm exec vitest run convex/archiveEntries.test.ts tests/service/server/archive-api.test.ts tests/service/client/archive-section.test.ts

additionalObservations: No fake adapter, shim, placeholder branch, or other non-real execution path was found in the directly touched production archive read surface.

The directly touched test helper update in `convex/test_helpers/fake_convex_context.ts` aligns the fake query builder with the new indexed range operators used by the Convex query, and it did not introduce a gate regression.
